review_reference: Owner, 2026-11-13 ("i need the outreach to be able to take more information ... whatever it takes to make this thing ready"), for the AccessCare Medical Outreach of 14 November 2026; to be signed by the owner, reviewed by Rahman.
evidence: Migration 0118_outreach_screening.sql (placeholder number; releases right after 0117) plus its runtime-grants.sql block. WHAT IT DOES: (1) outreach.registration_screenings, one screening per outreach registration case, every field optional, replaced whole on each save (version + 1): blood pressure, pulse, temperature, weight, height, blood glucose (value, mmol/L or mg/dL, fasting or random), malaria rapid test, hearing (each ear), main complaint, seen by a clinician and their name or role, outcome or advice, up to 10 medicines given (name, dose), referral and where; plausible-range CHECKs refuse typos. Forced RLS as the registration's: outreach.context_allows at the case's facility (read/write permission) and, restrictively, only for a case the session can see (its campaign's members, 0045). hid_outreach_runtime: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE; no DELETE. A trigger (SECURITY DEFINER, search_path pinned) checks the case at the same facility and not redacted, the session's own account and membership, version 1 then +1, and the first recording unchanged. The save's idempotency key and digest are kept on the row (outreach.command_idempotency unchanged). When a registration is redacted (0116's sweep or support), its screening row is deleted in the same transaction by a trigger on the case's redaction update, as the owner, in the retention run only (owner-only DELETE and SELECT policies limited to that run). (2) outreach.registration_cases.area: optional area, town or LGA (1-100), set at registration, never changed, cleared on redaction (a BEFORE UPDATE trigger). (3) The outreach-group notes cap: 280 to 1000 characters, one line of 0115's outreach.enforce_organiser_tenant_rules. (4) Organiser terms: 2026-11-14 is accepted beside 2026-11-01 in 0115's two activation commands (one line each). Lines 3 and 4 are replaced inside the live bodies, md5-pinned before (0115's) and checked after. The registration notice version is not pinned in the database. LOCKS: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE NOWAIT on outreach.registration_cases (the column and triggers), bounded at 5 s (else 55P03). Proven with superuser and with a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator (the new suite outreach-screening, 35 cases).
